checks.message: Provisional boundary is explicitly disclosed. It remains eligible for content review but must be replaced and recalculated when official geometry is supplied.
All three required key areas are present as provisional constraints and are not described as official redlines or precise-area evidence.
Land-use polygons form one complete, non-overlapping partition of the submitted provisional boundary.
Known spatial metrics declare formulas, source files, confidence and assumptions; provisional area metrics carry recalculation triggers.
Chinese and English proposals, reports, visuals, figures and PDFs follow the bilingual v2 contract and aligned chapter order.
Each of the 23 mandatory requirements has a requirement-specific chapter, layer, metric, visual, source, assumption and self-check mapping.
No field visit, resident interview, stakeholder consultation, real OD, verified curb rules or verified legal flexible capacity is claimed.
Hard Rights remain prior to operational allocation; capacity-limited conditions trigger physical redesign rather than more scheduling.
P4-SIM remains SEMISTATIC_SIM_PREFERRED; the package does not recommend Fully Dynamic or claim Wudaokou deployment evidence.
Public cases transfer only bounded mechanisms; provisional and background material is not promoted into statutory or implementation claims.
Bilingual static visual pages use local assets only and visibly disclose metrics, sources, assumptions and evidence boundaries.
Bilingual A3 and A0 PDFs contain readable pages, safe margins and consistent reviewer-facing branding.
Professional standards and design-depth items now use distinct, claim-relevant evidence chains; the architecture-depth data gap remains explicit.
All declared package files exist and non-manifest SHA-256 hashes are refreshed after rendering.
